title: Ask an agent for the rest
subtitle: The repository carries six skills: say what you want in your own words
bullets: “Plan a 20-minute talk on X from these papers” starts a deck with a storyboard you approve
“Check the slides” captures every slide and reviews the frames
“Pull the media” and “push the media” move pictures and videos to and from the asset store
“I'll watch on my iPad” serves the deck and takes your marked-up screenshots while it edits
“Record a run-through” films the deck, with a synthesized voice if you want one
